That works nicely. After I pasted the link and its details came up, the label picker was right there in the same pop-up — I checked "Recipes," typed in "Weekend plans," and saved, and the card came out showing both labels. Having the labels appear alongside the title and description once the link is recognized keeps it all in one smooth motion; I never had to go hunting for a separate step. That timing feels right.

Labeling is settled for me now. What's next?
